DB-E5.Description:
Conduct security audit against OWASP GenAI Top 10 and document compliance status.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Review each OWASP GenAI vulnerability (LLM01-LLM10)
- Document current mitigation status in docs/SECURITY.md
- Identify gaps requiring implementation
- Create test cases for each applicable vulnerability
- Update compliance matrix with test coverage links
- Add security checklist to PR template

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Security
DEPENDENCIES: DB-022

TESTING CRITERIA:
- All 10 vulnerabilities assessed
- Compliance matrix complete
- Test cases identified for each
- Gaps documented with remediation plan

EDGE CASES:
- N/A vulnerabilities: document why not applicable
- Partial mitigation: note remaining risk

Implement comprehensive output sanitization in Orchestrator using Bleach.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Create backend/security/sanitization.py
- Define ALLOWED_TAGS: p, h1-h6, ul, ol, li, strong, em, code, pre, blockquote, hr, br
- Define ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES: {} (none by default)
- Create sanitize_markdown() function using Bleach
- Integrate into Orchestrator presentation step
- Log any stripped content for security audit
- Add sanitization to all agent outputs before aggregation

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-017

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Script tags stripped
- Allowed tags preserved
- Attributes removed
- Logging captures stripped content

EDGE CASES:
- Nested malicious tags
- Unicode encoding attacks
- Markdown code blocks preserved

Implement hard circuit breaker for token budget enforcement.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Define token budgets per agent in constants: Task=3000, Calendar=3000, Focus=6000, Critic=5000
- Define hard limit multiplier: 2x (e.g., Focus hard limit = 12000)
- Create should_circuit_break() function checking total_tokens against limits
- Integrate into LangGraph conditional edges
- On circuit break: immediately route to DLQ with reason=token_budget_exceeded
- Track budget metrics: token_budget_utilization gauge

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-018, DB-023

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Budget tracked accurately
- 2x limit triggers circuit break
- DLQ entry created
- Metric reflects utilization

EDGE CASES:
- Budget exceeded mid-generation: stop and return partial
- Multiple agents exceed: aggregate for total
- Reset on new request

Implement per-endpoint rate limiting with slowapi.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Add slowapi to dependencies
- Configure limiter with Redis backend (or in-memory for dev)
- Limits: /api/v1/briefing/generate = 10/min, /api/v1/export = 5/hour, /api/v1/* = 60/min
- Return 429 with Retry-After header on exceed
- Exempt /health and /metrics from limiting
- Log rate limit violations with IP and endpoint

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-006

TESTING CRITERIA:
- 429 returned on limit exceed
- Retry-After header present
- Health endpoint not limited
- Limits per-IP not global

EDGE CASES:
- Redis unavailable: fall back to in-memory
- Distributed environment: Redis required
- IPv6 addresses handled correctly

- Add PII detection to AgentResultEnvelope validation

PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: DB-026

EDGE CASES:
